decisive_items: nail thickening over the pigmented band
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
response.rationale: The clinical finding of nail thickening over a longitudinal pigmented band and the histologic villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate strongly favor onychomatricoma over onychopapilloma.

rejected.why: Onychopapilloma is less consistent with the prominent nail thickening and villous fibroepithelial projections; it more classically presents with longitudinal erythronychia and distal subungual keratosis rather than this proximal pigmented band with nail thickening.
